_comment: Tier-2 for the universal [Setup] claim in _common.py: 'global nrho <n> fnum <F>' issued AFTER create_particles, or omitted, leaves the domain empty and says nothing. Executes the entry's full Signal — the setup line reads 'Created 0 particles' AND the Np column is 0 on all three stats lines — plus the three properties that make it dangerous: rc=0, zero ERROR lines, zero WARNING lines, and a complete stats table still printed. The control run is the SAME deck with the global line moved before create_particles: 999 particles, Np nonzero throughout. Nothing is pinned; the assertion is nonzero-versus-exactly-zero. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 with SPARTA (24 Sep 2025). This claim previously looked covered by generators_execute_on_installed_build, which was keyed to it while executing a catalog-wide generator smoke test that never touches nrho ordering. POSITIONAL ALIASES added 2026-08-06: this fixture's universal claims are also listed at their slots in the rarefied_flow row. The identity key 'universal:<n>' counts each shared claim once, which is correct; but an external counter walking rarefied_flow's 19 positional slots cannot see it and reports the claim as uncovered. Listing both makes the coverage visible under either convention; the gate collapses the alias onto the identity key so it is still counted once. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 moves the `global nrho ... fnum ...` line BACK IN FRONT of create_particles in the two runs that are supposed to come out empty, removing the ordering pathology and changing nothing else; all three runs then report Created 999 particles. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: created_line_reads_exactly_zero_both_ways=True, np_is_zero_on_every_stats_line=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/global_nrho_before_create_particles && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line. POSITIONAL ALIAS REPOINTED 2026-08-07: eight new rarefied_flow claims were inserted ahead of the shared universal block, moving it from slots 9-18 to 17-26. This fixture's rarefied_flow:<n> entries are the positional spelling of the universal:<n> claims it already names by identity, so only the alias number changed; the evidence, the decks and the mutation control are untouched. The runner key moved with it: pitfall_index 9 -> 17, so this fixture still writes its own row in tier2_results.json.
